mode.form: 4 Favorite teams, 5 Live games (1 to 3 are older live modes; 0, My team before, is taken as 4)

fav1.form: league:id, or none or empty to clear the remote's slot 1

fav2.form: league:id, or none or empty to clear the remote's slot 2

fav3.form: league:id, or none or empty to clear the remote's slot 3

fav4.form: league:id, or none or empty to clear the remote's slot 4

tz.form: a timezone's display name, its IANA name, or its index in the panel's list

tzauto.form: 1 on, anything else off: follow the browser's timezone

panels.form: panels wide, 1 or 2; the panel restarts into the new layout

lockon.form: minutes before kickoff, clamped to 5 to 120

release.form: seconds after the final, clamped to 30 to 3600

collide.form: 1 alternate between two favorites playing at once, 0 stick with the higher one

favs.form: league:id,league:id,... in order, up to 16; empty clears the list; unknown teams and repeats drop out

live.form: league keys, comma separated, like nfl,mlb; empty puts Live games back on automatic

countdown.form: 1 shows the countdown to the next game between games, anything else off

top25.form: 1 shows the college Top 25 card between games while the panel follows a college team, anything else off

news.form: 1 shows the news card (ESPN headlines) between games, anything else off

gameleaders.form: 1 shows the Game leaders card at halftime and the final, anything else off

town.form: the weather card's town or US ZIP code, trimmed, up to 40 bytes cut on a whole character; control characters, emoji and bytes that aren't UTF-8 are dropped; a new town is looked up with Open-Meteo and turns the card on, the same town again only retries a lookup that found nothing; empty clears the town and turns the card off

wxon.form: 1 shows the weather card between games, anything else off; applied after town in the same request

cdname.form: the custom countdown's name, trimmed, up to 20 bytes cut on a whole character; control characters and bytes that aren't UTF-8 are dropped; empty clears it

cddate.form: the custom countdown's day, YYYY-MM-DD, 2020 to 2099; none or empty clears it

msg.form: the message card's own text; cleaned to what the panel can draw

msgurl.form: an http or https address of a text file, at most 160 bytes, or empty for none

msgevery.form: minutes between message cards, a whole number, clamped to 0 to 30

best.form: 1 pick the best game, anything else a random one

celebrate.form: 0 off, 1 subtle, 2 full; anything else is refused

night.form: 1 runs the night schedule, anything else off

nightstart.form: HH:MM, 24-hour, like the page's time field

nightend.form: HH:MM, 24-hour, like the page's time field

nightscreen.form: 1 screen on at the night brightness, anything else screen off

nick.form: the panel's nickname, up to 32 bytes; emoji and bytes that aren't UTF-8 are dropped; empty clears it

lists.form: Name=league:id,league:id;Name=... up to 16 playlists of favorites, names up to 16 bytes without ; or =; empty clears them. A playlist's teams may carry its options as tokens: @d:<digits> the days of its schedule (0 Sunday to 6 Saturday), @t:HH:MM-HH:MM its hours on those days (left out: all day; an end before the start runs into the next morning), @only (Only this list's games), @today:1 or @today:0 (its own Only today's games; left out: the switch)

list.form: the playlist Favorite teams plays, 1 to 16 in the lists order, 0 for every favorite; past the last playlist is refused

sport.form: the sport row Favorite teams plays, one of the state's sports (football, baseball, basketball, hockey, soccer), or none to stop it and play every favorite; a sport with no row is refused; with a sport picked, list in the same request is ignored

hook.form: the game events' webhook, an http address on the home network, at most 160 bytes, or empty for none; https is refused

remote1.form: what WizMote button 1 does: fav (its own favorite, the default), team:league:id (a favorite team), list:Name (one of the playlists, by name), sport:football|baseball|basketball|hockey|soccer (a sport row), all (every favorite) or none; a team or sport the panel doesn't know is refused

remote2.form: what WizMote button 2 does, as remote1

remote3.form: what WizMote button 3 does, as remote1

remote4.form: what WizMote button 4 does, as remote1

pregame.form: minutes before the start for the reminder event, a whole number, clamped to 0 to 120; 0 sends none

wake.form: 1 turns Game-day wake on, anything else off

wakelead.form: minutes before the start the wake turns the panel on, a whole number, clamped to 5 to 120

after.form: what the panel does once a final has lingered: scoreboard, off or clock; any other word is refused

cards.form: the Between games list: id:1 turns a card on and id:0 off, comma separated, ids from the state's cards list; the cards it doesn't name stay as they are; an id the panel doesn't have is skipped; countdown, top25, news and gameleaders are the same switches as those keys, and weather is wxon
